title: Feeling Sick
text:
Anna has a cold. She has a headache and a sore throat. She stays at home and drinks a lot of water. Her mother gives her some soup.

Anna goes to the doctor the next day. The doctor checks her ears and her throat. He says she needs to rest for three days. Anna feels better after one week.

questions.text: Where does Anna go the next day?
How does Anna's mother probably feel?
What can we guess about Anna after one week?

vocabulary.definition: an illness that makes your nose run and makes you feel tired
to relax and not work or move much
a person who helps sick people

paragraph_translations: Anna está resfriada. Ela tem dor de cabeça e dor de garganta. Ela fica em casa e bebe muita água. A mãe dela lhe dá um pouco de sopa.
Anna vai ao médico no dia seguinte. O médico examina os ouvidos e a garganta dela. Ele diz que ela precisa descansar por três dias. Anna se sente melhor depois de uma semana.
